a1c67646-6a75-504a-9508-d69e1d04b3e5.content: The user keeps the shared laundry-room access card in an entrance drawer.

9479e799-95d7-50d2-af62-d1e0914a389b.content: The user went downstairs 25 minutes after the laundry finished and received a note from another household.

528cb5ea-8c36-5206-beaa-19432250ec4d.content: For the next load, the user set a reminder five minutes before the end and removed the laundry immediately.

85fb1639-2176-5329-b490-3325ff030db4.content: The user washed light-colored clothes with new jeans, and color transferred onto white socks.

431d170a-863f-596d-97c0-0c9634524ee5.content: The user later washed the new jeans separately, and the color of the other clothes did not change.

4df33adc-cfba-50f2-b141-e2ebed38b81c.content: On a day the user did not check the dryer filter, the clothes needed another drying cycle.

ba7daae9-938d-55a1-af20-21cd10d395d8.content: On the next use, after emptying the filter, the user finished drying in one cycle.

abbf8742-38e3-5810-b222-fe91e3340962.content: The building manager judges that not leaving finished laundry for a long time is fair to other households.

06273d22-0b42-5c55-9d70-eda14084219a.content: When creating a shared laundry-room reminder, base it on the end time of the machine the user started.

03ac930e-d745-5c29-8c24-5ced669817f9.content: Even if the local agent knows where the card is kept, it cannot know which machines in the shared laundry room are currently available.
